headline: Indian IT services posted solid top‑line growth with AI emerging as a key profit driver.
summary: Revenue rose across most majors, led by TCS (+15% YoY) and HCLTech (+11.5% YoY). Profit margins improved for several firms, notably Coforge which lifted its EBIT guidance to 16%. AI revenue grew sharply, especially at HCLTech (78% YoY) and TCS (crossed $3.1 bn). Guidance was mixed, with Infosys trimming FY27 growth expectations while Wipro introduced a short‑term outlook.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI sales jumped 47‑78% YoY, boosting margins at HCLTech, TCS and LTM.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Operating margins rose above 20% at TCS and Coforge, reflecting higher‑value deals.

themes.title: Guidance divergence
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 growth guidance, whereas Coforge raised its EBIT margin target.
